description.value:
The Edit — Surge spends, allocated in the cast dialog.

  • Emphasis (1) — your next Strike or manifestation hits for +Tier d6 (the word, underlined).
  • Stabilize (2) — you gain DR equal to Tier; your next cast resists counter/dispel (the sentence holds).
  • Impose a Reading (3) — a foe's next attack and its saves are at disadvantage: in the dialog this raises your working's save DC and forces the target to roll 3d10 keep-lowest-2. Only one correct interpretation: yours.
  • Rewrite the Sentence (5) — a foe loses its reactions and rolls saves at disadvantage; allies near you bank a reroll.

These are the old Resonance channels spoken in the one currency: Surge. The Sentence (Initiation 11) endures as your signature stance on top of them.
